people.name: Chinnereth

translations.web: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.
translations.bsb: On one occasion, while Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret with the crowd pressing in on Him to hear the word of God,
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,
